ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: After ignoring the curved arrows, there are two chemical components in the figure that are not bonded to each other. The upper component is a phosphoryl chloride structure: P is double-bonded to O and single-bonded to three Cl, namely O=PCl3. The lower component is an amide: the left wildcard substituent is connected to the carbonyl carbon, forming *C(=O)-; the carbonyl is then connected to NH; NH is connected to a benzene ring; this benzene ring is further connected to another benzene ring, and the other benzene ring bears a wildcard substituent. Reasoning: The upper phosphoryl chloride is converted to the SMILES O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl. The lower organic amide-biphenyl fragment is converted to the SMILES *C(=O)Nc1ccccc1-c1ccc(*)cc1. Because the two components are separated in the figure, the SMILES connects them with a dot. Therefore the overall expression is *C(=O)Nc1ccccc1-c1ccc(*)cc1.O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the drawing as two separate chemical components, excluding the curved arrows: the upper component is phosphoryl chloride, O=PCl3; the lower component is an amide where a wildcard acyl substituent is attached to C(=O), then NH is bonded to a phenyl ring, which is connected to another phenyl ring bearing a wildcard substituent. Convert the organic fragment to SMILES as *C(=O)Nc1ccccc1-c1ccc(*)cc1, convert POCl3 to O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl, and join the disconnected components with a dot to obtain *C(=O)Nc1ccccc1-c1ccc(*)cc1.O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：忽略弯曲箭头后，图中有两个彼此未成键的化学组分。上方组分是一个磷酰氯结构：P 与 O 双键相连，并与三个 Cl 单键相连，即 O=PCl3。下方组分是一个酰胺：左侧通配取代基连接到羰基碳，形成 *C(=O)-；羰基再连接到 NH；NH 连接到一个苯环；该苯环再与另一个苯环相连，另一个苯环上带有一个通配取代基。推理：上方的磷酰氯转换为 SMILES 为 O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl。下方有机酰胺-联苯片段转换为 SMILES 为 *C(=O)Nc1ccccc1-c1ccc(*)cc1。因为两个组分在图中是分离的，SMILES 用点号连接。因此整体表达式为 *C(=O)Nc1ccccc1-c1ccc(*)cc1.O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl。

planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the non-arrow atoms and bonds: a POCl3 fragment with P=O and three P–Cl bonds, plus an anilide/biphenyl fragment containing a carbonyl C=O bonded to a generic R group and to NH, with N bonded to one phenyl ring that is biaryl-linked to a second phenyl ring bearing R1. Ignore all curved arrows and electron-pair marks.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to know the requested output format is a SMILES expression and that arrows in the transition-state drawing must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply standard skeletal-structure-to-SMILES conventions: unlabeled aromatic carbons become lowercase aromatic ring notation, generic substituent labels R/R1 are represented as wildcard atoms '*', disconnected species are separated by '.', carbonyl is C(=O), amide linkage is C(=O)N, and phosphoryl chloride is written as O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl.
